title: Check a public hospital's performance
summary: Use the Bureau of Health Information (BHI) online tool to check the performance of public hospitals in NSW.
intro:
The Bureau of Health Information (BHI) is an independent body reporting on the performance of the NSW health system.

The BHI provides an online tool to check the emergency department and elective surgery performance of more than 80 public hospitals in NSW.
